sources.title: colpali-v1.3: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview colpali-v1.3 is a visual document retriever built on PaliGemma-3B that generates ColBERT-style multi-vector representations from document images and text queries. Maintained by vidore, this model efficiently indexes PDF-type documents by mapping image patches and text tokens into a shared latent space, enabling late-interaction scoring between queries and document pages. sources.title: GitHub - illuin-tech/colpali: The code used to train and run inference ...
sources.snippet: This repository contains the code used for training and running visual document retrievers introduced by the ColPali: Efficient Document Retrieval with Vision Language Models paper. It includes the original ColPali model, based on the ColBERT architecture and the PaliGemma model, along with later ColVision and bi-encoder retriever variants.
